name: iban_validate
description: Validate IBANs (ISO 13616): allowed characters, the country's length, the mod-97 check digits, and the BBAN split into bank, branch and account for common countries; Spanish account check digits are verified too. Also builds an IBAN from a country and BBAN.

iban.description: One IBAN; spaces, dashes and an IBAN prefix are ignored

catalog.source: ISO 13616 and the SWIFT IBAN Registry; Spanish CCC check digits; ideas from python-stdnum (github.com/arthurdejong/python-stdnum)
